preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(-100 <= a[i][j] <= 100 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each integer in the table must be between -100 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in a)
preconditions.description: The input table must have exactly n rows and each row must have exactly m integers.

postconditions.expression: len(row_spells) == a and all(1 <= row <= n for row in row_spells)
postconditions.description: The number of row spells applied must match the count a, and all row numbers must be valid.

postconditions.expression: len(col_spells) == b and all(1 <= col <= m for col in col_spells)
postconditions.description: The number of column spells applied must match the count b, and all column numbers must be valid.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(a[i][j] for j in range(m)) >= 0 for i in range(n)) and all(sum(a[i][j] for i in range(n)) >= 0 for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: After applying the spells, the sum of each row and each column must be non-negative.
